entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Hot Reload: CascadingParameterState static cache is never cleared, so new [CascadingParameter] additions require a restart #67624
  • Perf improvement: json, multiple_queries #67622
  • Expose configured endpoint names on ListenOptions #67619
  • Accessibility: QuickGrid Paginator link mode puts aria-label on boundary anchor elements that have no href or role #67615
  • Accessibility: scaffolded Identity validation summary produces an invalid ul with role=alert #67614
  • [Hot Reload with dotnet watch] Blazor WASM Standalone hot reload reports changes applied but UI is not updated in .NET 11 Preview 6 #67611

Closed

  • Perf improvement: json, json, json #67604
  • Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi nuget has dependency on Microsoft.OpenAPI with CVE-2026-49451 #67505
    10.0.x

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/9.0] Update branding to 9.0.19 #67623
  • [release/8.0] Update branding to 8.0.30 #67621
  • Rerun PostRoutingPipeline on Rerouting #67618
    feature-antiforgery
  • Add analyzer for RazorComponentResult parameter validation #67617
    community-contribution
  • [Blazor] Preserve null values for <option value="@null"> in select binding #67616
    community-contribution
  • Add Forbidden state support to AuthorizeView #67613
  • SignalR .NET client: make auth refresh work behind a redirecting server (Azure SignalR) #67612
    community-contribution

Merged

  • Normalize C++ PlatformToolsetVersion and centralize PlatformToolset #67552
  • [test-quarantine] Fix guardrails that let the workflow re-attempt rejected actions #67620
  • [release/10.0] Update OpenApi to 2.7.5 #67464
    tell-mode

Updated

  • [release/11.0-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #67439
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • Fix OpenApiSchemaService to handle implementation different from Dictionary<,> for schema.Properties #67384
    community-contribution
  • Fix service parameter detection logic for minimal API validation filter #67578
  • Reject connection-specific headers sent via HPACK/QPACK indexed names #67584
    area-networking
  • Clarify ActionLink URL generation documentation #67481
    community-contribution
  • Drop redundant fixed in HttpSys SetDataChunkWithPinnedData #66578
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Fix ValidationsGenerator ITypeParameterSymbol handling #65419
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • Improve diagnostic logging for ComponentState lifecycle transitions #67585
    community-contribution
  • Creating Blazor Gateway CLI package and tests #67599
  • Warn on Blazor components with Dispose()/DisposeAsync() but no interface #67426
    community-contribution
  • Fix RDG check for endpoint uniqueness #67591
  • Adding analyzer to warn about JSInterop calls not wrapped in a try catch block #67530
    area-blazor, analyzer, community-contribution
  • Fix Flaky test: FormsInputDateTest.InputDateInteractsWithEditContext_NullableDateTimeOffset #67513
  • Fixed AmbiguousMatchException in DataAnnotationsValidator for Hidden Members #67075
    area-blazor, community-contribution
  • Fix Blazor passkey registration under CsrfProtection #67589
  • 1029637: Added Grid Layout Support to Virtualize Component with ItemWidth and ItemHeight #67478
    community-contribution
  • Add OnPageChanging and OnPageChanged event support to Paginator #67380
    community-contribution
  • Provide the column resize support to Quick Grid component #67120
    area-blazor
  • Harden Blazor WebView disposal races for JSRuntime and IPC #67026
    area-blazor
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #67503
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
